description: Contextual medium-density residential district. Quality Housing mandatory. Produces lower-rise buildings (4-5 stories) typical of brownstone neighborhoods. Lower FAR than R6A.

bulk.far_note: UAP standard. R6B is lower-density than R6A. Community facility FAR per ZR §24-11.

height_setback.street_wall_setback_wide_st: 10 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_setback_narrow_st: 15 ft depth above max base height
height_setback.street_wall_location: No closer to street line than buildings within 150 ft on same block
height_setback.notes: Per ZR §23-432 table (R6B row). R6B produces ~4-5 story buildings. Max building height 55 ft standard; 65 ft qualifying.

front.note: Open area between street wall and street line: permitted obstructions per §23-41

side.requirement: Per §23-335: none required for Quality Housing contextual districts
side.note: No rear yard required at lot line coinciding with adjoining side lot line

rear.through_lot_alternative: Rear yard equivalent per §23-343 on through lots ≥180 ft; per §23-343 paragraph (a)

dob_filing_notes: Quality Housing Program certification required in DOB NOW
